about_the_game:
The secret is hidden at the bottom of the cup. Do you dare take a sip?

On Halloween eve, a special menu of five mysterious drinks appears at the Serenity Coffee Shop, but their secret recipes are suddenly stolen. The new heroine, the cunning and charming Lucy, wants to reveal the secrets of the Halloween menu first. You and your team must beat her to it and recover the recipes to save the celebration.This unique Halloween quest will add to your adventure:

— Total immersion in the holiday: The coffee shop and its surroundings have been transformed! Pumpkins, cobwebs, mysterious lights, and other decorations will create a unique atmosphere for the spookiest night of the year.
— Parade of costumes: All main and secondary characters, including your team, will be dressed in unique festive outfits. Discover new facets of their personalities by looking at their choice of image.
— New twists and turns: Time to prepare for the holiday is rapidly running out, and in one eventful evening, you will experience a series of unexpected events and emotional discoveries that will reveal unexpected sides to the characters.

Dive into the Halloween atmosphere, solve the secrets faster than Lucy, and restore the legendary recipes before the night is over!
